English (the core figure): The market regulator’s Party group lists the Nvidia case, with its cases on Qualcomm and DuPont China, under “坚决落实党中央重大决策部署” (carrying out the Party centre’s major decisions) and “敢于斗争” (daring to struggle) (Party members’ paper, Sept 24, 2026). Nvidia’s reports say the preliminary finding concerns the “degraded products” US export controls required it to offer the Chinese market. A standing rule cuts the other way: the regulator’s 2020 approval of Nvidia’s Mellanox purchase obliges Nvidia to keep supplying its accelerators to the Chinese market, unless lifted since (the parties may apply to lift the conditions six years after they took effect) (decision).
Chinese: 市场监管总局党组把英伟达案与高通公司、杜邦中国集团的案件一并列在“坚决落实党中央重大决策部署”和“敢于斗争”之下（共产党员手机报，2026年9月24日）。英伟达的报告说，初步调查结论涉及美国出口管制要求它向中国市场提供的降规产品（原文：“degraded products”）。有一项规定（如未解除）方向正相反：市场监管总局2020年附条件批准英伟达收购迈络思，条件之一是英伟达须“向中国市场继续供应英伟达GPU加速器”；交易双方可在条件生效6年后申请解除（公告全文）。

English (the core figure): Beijing
Chinese: 北京方面

English (the core figure): The companies
Chinese: 企业

English (the core figure): Open marks rest on unnamed people. In the answers found, no Chinese authority confirmed any of them: asked about such reports, the foreign ministry said it was not aware of the matter (Aug 13, 2025), that the question should go to the competent departments (Jan 29, 2026), and that its position on US chips was consistent (Nov 9, 2026).
Chinese: 空心圆点依据的是未具名人士的说法。在找到的答复中，没有中国主管部门证实其中任何一条：被问到这类报道时，外交部发言人先后表示“我不了解你提到的情况”（2025年8月13日）、“具体问题建议向中方主管部门进行询问”（2026年1月29日）、“中方在美国输华芯片问题上的立场是一贯的”（2026年11月9日）。

English (the core figure): No published Chinese order against buying Nvidia chips was found in the policy pages and national document lists read. The published acts against Nvidia that were found are a summons and an antitrust case. The public warnings found came in one burst: of 42 state and Party media items on Nvidia chips found from Jul 2025 to Nov 2026, the 7 that only warn about Nvidia’s chips all date from Aug 1, 2025 to Sept 24, 2025 (4 others mix a warning with a welcome), and none of them is an order. Earlier, on Dec 3, 2024, an industry body, the Internet Society of China, had called on companies to be careful in choosing to buy American chips, citing US export controls, and in the same sentence to use chips made in China by domestic and foreign-funded firms alike.
Chinese: 在所阅读的政策网页和全国性文件目录中，没有找到公开发布的、不准购买英伟达芯片的中国政府命令。找到的针对英伟达的公开举措，是一次约谈和一起反垄断案件。找到的公开警示集中在一段时间：在2025年7月至2026年11月间找到的42篇涉及英伟达芯片的官方媒体和党媒内容中，只对英伟达芯片提出警示的7篇全部出自2025年8月1日至2025年9月24日（另有4篇既有警示也有欢迎），其中没有一篇是命令。更早的2024年12月3日，行业组织中国互联网协会曾以美国出口管制为由，呼吁企业“审慎选择采购美国芯片”，并在同一句话里呼吁“积极使用内外资企业在华生产制造的芯片”。

English (the core figure): Records 4 and 16 are an antitrust case against Nvidia the company. By Nvidia’s own reports the preliminary finding concerns the degraded products that US export controls required it to offer the Chinese market. They are drawn orange as pressure on Nvidia, not as a wish for fewer Nvidia chips. The White House said on Nov 1, 2025 that China would end its investigations of US firms in the chip supply chain, naming none; neither the regulator’s own news list (read to Nov 23, 2026) nor Nvidia’s reports say the Nvidia case has ended, and the regulator’s review of its 2025 work, posted Apr 10, 2026, lists the further investigation.
Chinese: 第4条和第16条记录是针对英伟达公司本身的反垄断案件。按英伟达自己的报告，初步调查结论涉及美国出口管制要求其向中国市场提供的降规产品。这两条画成橙色，表示对英伟达的压力，并不表示希望英伟达芯片减少。白宫2025年11月1日说，中国将终止对芯片供应链上美国企业的各项调查，但没有点名；市场监管总局自己的新闻列表（读至2026年11月23日）和英伟达的报告都没有说英伟达案已经结束，总局2026年4月10日发布的2025年工作回顾仍列有“对英伟达公司实施进一步调查”。

English (the core figure): What Beijing meant is not settled. American bodies read its antitrust moves as leverage or pressure: the US-China commission (2025), “exert leverage and ease pressure as a negotiating tactic”; the Congressional Research Service (Sept 2025), “to pressure Nvidia to provide its advanced chips to China”. Yet asked whether China would let its companies buy the H200, the Trade Representative said “that’s gonna be a sovereign decision for China” (May 15, 2026, Bloomberg Television; captions, not checked by ear, at 05:59). Either reading leaves the direction of the acts drawn here as it is.
Chinese: 北京方面的用意并无定论。美国的一些机构把它的反垄断举措看作筹码或施压：美中经济与安全审查委员会（2025年）认为，这显示中国愿意把施加影响和缓解压力都用作谈判手段（原文：“exert leverage and ease pressure as a negotiating tactic”）；国会研究服务处（2025年9月）认为，这是为了向英伟达施压，要它向中国提供先进芯片（原文：“to pressure Nvidia to provide its advanced chips to China”）。不过，被问到中国是否会让本国企业购买H200时，美国贸易代表说，那将是中国的主权决定（原文：“that’s gonna be a sovereign decision for China”；2026年5月15日，彭博电视；字幕，未经人耳核对，05:59处）。无论取哪一种解读，这里所画各项举措的方向都不变。

English (the core figure): The H200 also had to pass American conditions: testing in the United States, a cap at half of the shipments to American customers, and a 25% tariff (Commerce Department rule of Jan 15, 2026; Nvidia’s report for the quarter ended Jul 26, 2026). By May 11, 2026 Washington had returned without action 1,888,950 of the 3,444,160 chips in the applications listed, more than half of that list (the bars above). The committee that released the table says the summary does not show every application in full; its example is an Nvidia application of Dec 19, 2025 for 445,000 chips for Tencent, which the table shows at 75,000.
Chinese: H200还须过美方的条件：在美国境内检测、数量不超过发往美国客户的一半、缴纳25%的关税（美国商务部2026年1月15日的规则；英伟达截至2026年7月26日季度的报告）。截至2026年5月11日，在表内所列申请的3,444,160枚芯片中，华盛顿未予处理即退回的有1,888,950枚，超过该表所列的一半（见上方条形图）。公布这份表格的委员会说，这份汇总没有完整反映每一份申请；它举的例子是英伟达2025年12月19日为腾讯申请44.5万枚的一份申请，表中只显示为7.5万枚。

English (the core figure): The chip at issue changed over time: the H20 (2024 to 2025), the RTX Pro 6000D (2025), the H200 (from December 2025).
Chinese: 所涉芯片前后有变化：H20（2024年至2025年）、RTX Pro 6000D（2025年）、H200（2025年12月起）。

English (the core figure): The records are a selection made to show both sides, not a census. The count of marks in a row is not a measure.
Chinese: 这些记录是为呈现双方情况而作的选取，不是全面统计。某一行圆点的多少不代表分量。

English (the core figure): Records 1 and 2 are not about Nvidia. Record 1 is the 2023 review conclusion that failed Micron’s products, a published instruction to operators of critical information infrastructure to stop buying one foreign chip maker’s products; record 2 is a purchase rule for Party and state bodies’ desktop computers. They are drawn in orange as steps away from foreign chips. Record 30 is two universities’ own buying, in notices that hold suppliers to the government procurement law’s conditions; it is not an act of the central government. Records 35 and 37 do not name Nvidia; they are drawn blue because they back Chinese firms’ computing abroad, where by record 47 Nvidia chips are used. Records 42 and 55 are a city body’s and a Party journal’s documents about what the companies use; they are drawn in the companies’ row.
Chinese: 第1条和第2条记录与英伟达无关。第1条是2023年认定美光产品未通过审查的结论，是一项公开发布的、要求关键信息基础设施运营者停止采购一家外国芯片厂商产品的指示；第2条是针对党政机关台式计算机的采购规定。这两条画成橙色，表示远离外国芯片的举措。第30条是两所高校自己的采购，其公告要求供应商符合政府采购法规定的条件；这不是中央政府的举措。第35条和第37条没有提到英伟达；画成蓝色，是因为它们支持中国企业在境外使用算力，而按第47条记录，那里用的是英伟达芯片。第42条和第55条是一个市级部门和一份党刊关于企业用什么芯片的文件；它们画在企业一栏。
